_doc: What the ops-intake router may do on whose word. This file is the model: scripts/ops_intake/policy.py reads it on every ask, and scripts/check-ops-intake-policy.sh (CI: scripts/tests/check-ops-intake-policy.bats) fails the PR that makes it unsafe - a W2 action reachable from the Slack surface, a W1 action with no recorded inverse, a class with no action plan, or a cap that is missing/zero. Same posture as policies/credit-approval-automation.json: the registry must say what the code does, and the guard proves it.

R.label: read-only
R.description: Explain, summarize, count, report, relay into an ask row. Never writes to a customer system.
R.granted_by: every requester in policies/ops-requesters.json, staff or not (staff_tier / unknown_tier)

W1.label: reversible write
W1.description: A single write that records an inverse the router can execute. Each write is one action-ledger row (#1702 shape, scripts/ops_intake/ledger.py) carrying that inverse; a W1 action whose inverse recipe is missing is refused by code, not by policy prose.

intercom_internal_note.description: Post an internal note on the Intercom conversation the ask names.
intercom_internal_note.inverse_detail: DELETE /conversations/{id}/parts/{part_id} (Intercom internal note); recorded on the ledger row as the note part id.

intercom_customer_reply.description: Reply to the customer with a line from plugins/intercom/src/answer-bank.ts.
intercom_customer_reply.inverse_detail: the reply can be retracted by a following admin note naming the ledger row; the customer-visible text never changes, which is why this is W1 only for answer-bank lines and W2 for anything composed.

clickup_status_move.description: Move one ClickUp task to another status/list.
clickup_status_move.inverse_detail: PUT /task/{id} with the previous status recorded on the ledger row.

profile_rename.description: PUT /admin/profile/{id} displayName to a value the ask names verbatim.
profile_rename.inverse_detail: PUT the previous displayName captured immediately before the write.

request_status_uvn.description: Move a credit request to user_verification_needed (the ask-for-proof state).
request_status_uvn.inverse_detail: PUT the request back to the status recorded on the ledger row before the write.

register_row.description: Append a row to a hydra register (erasure_requests, asks).
register_row.inverse_detail: the register's own delete path keyed by the row id on the ledger row.

hide_pr_open.description: Open the reversible hide PR (H-DevOps HIDDEN_ENTITY_IDS + PDP sitemap). A person merges; the router never merges.
hide_pr_open.inverse_detail: close the PR named on the ledger row - nothing is hidden until a human merges.

W2.label: irreversible / not-yet-invertible
W2.description: NEVER from a Slack message, for anyone, including the captain. The reply names the human path instead. A W2 action appearing in any tier's action list fails CI.

admin_profile_delete.why: Not reversible and NOT the legal path: AGENTS.md forbids it (legal hold 1350), the erasure register classifies the result as removed_outside_process, and the 2026-11-04 Gene Flores read-back showed 431 -> 0 served credits. 17 'hide profile' asks in 14 days took this path.
admin_profile_delete.human_path: scripts/gdpr-pipeline.py prepare (erasure register) -> H-DevOps hide PR -> a named human merges

profile_merge.why: No unmerge manifest exists today, so a merge cannot be inverted.
profile_merge.human_path: a named human session with an unmerge manifest (scripts/merge-verify.py names the command)

credit_approve.why: Captain decision. Codex/QA verdicts inside an agent turn already produced misattributed 'Firstmate' verdicts (census §7).

credit_removal.endpoint: admin credit delete / approved -> unverified take-back
credit_removal.why: core-backend #10310 refuses every agent/API token on these routes.
credit_removal.human_path: scripts/credit-retro.py from a named human's own session

refund.why: Money. Needs a human approver recorded.
refund.human_path: billing owner in a named human session

W2._triggers_doc: Each W2 action carries the phrases that request it. scripts/ops_intake/policy.py compiles these and the router refuses the whole ask (state=refused) when a W2 trigger fires, naming the human path - a W1 note or a status move must never ride in on a sentence that also asks for an irreversible write.

proof-review.notes: Verdict comes ONLY from scripts/credit-review.py's coded outcomes (proof.sqlite / doc-verify.sqlite). No model judges a credit on this surface; a missing verdict is reported as pending with a due time, never guessed.

summarize-resolve.notes: The summary is read-only. 'Do the resolution' may request W1 (note / answer-bank reply / status->UVN). Refund, merge, approve and delete inside the same sentence are refused as W2 with the human path named.

gdpr-hide.notes: The ONLY hide path is the reversible HIDDEN_ENTITY_IDS PR, and only for a page the register itself calls hide-eligible (gdpr_pipeline.identity.HIDE_ELIGIBLE: PASS_A-D, LEGAL_HIDE_FIRST). A page with NO register row, an UNKNOWN verdict, or any ASK_* verdict gets state=ask (no write) - the 2026-11-04 census found a hide executed while the register identity was UNKNOWN.

clickup-categorize.notes: Counts are produced and reconciled by code (scripts/clickup-todo-dedupe.py header documents the failure of moving tickets to 'waiting' by hand).

status-report.notes: Numbers come from a coded query or are reported as unavailable. Never from an agent's recollection.

fraud-scan.notes: Reports the fraud lens band/holds only. 'Reject all credit claims including approved ones' is credit_removal = W2 (scripts/credit-retro.py, named human).

billing.notes: Read/trace only. A refund is W2.

profile-edit.notes: Renaming is W1 with the previous name as inverse. Creating a profile or a source link is refused to the agent (needs a human).

relay.notes: The ask row IS the queue (#1702 ledger + ops_asks). 'Queued' is only ever said with the row id and a due time that the watcher escalates.

other.notes: The only class the agent turn still sees: free-form process questions. It still gets an ask row.

caps._doc: Burst caps, counted from the action ledger. Over a cap the ask is HELD (state=held) and paged - never silently executed and never silently dropped.

fraud_lens._doc: Required before ANY W1 that touches a profile or a request. A lens result of unknown/unmeasurable is NOT consent: the write is refused and the reply says what could not be measured.

quarantine._doc: Inputs are data. A HIGH injection-watch hit in anything fetched for an ask quarantines it: the model never sees it, state=quarantined, page.

canary._doc: Every tool-less prompt carries a canary token; its appearance in an output fails the ask closed.

reply._doc: One format for every class (spec j2 item 5).

channels._doc: Channels the operations account answer-routes. Must stay a subset of the channels the `operations` Slack account is bound to in openclaw-main.json (CI-checked).
